result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: an invalid '€NaN' delivery price for Smash Bros Burgers that indicates a data formatting failure.

issues.description: Under 'Smash Bros Burgers' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel the delivery fee displays as '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price.
issues.suggestion: Fix data formatting / fallback handling so null or undefined fees do not render as NaN; display a valid formatted price like '€0.90 delivery' or hide the fee if unavailable.
